# The 2025 LLM Usage Landscape: Real-World Data from OpenRouter

## Data Source
OpenRouter is one of the largest LLM API aggregation platforms, capturing real usage data from millions of users. The data below is sourced from the OpenRouter Rankings page (https://openrouter.ai/rankings) and covers the most recent week of March 2025.

## Weekly Model Usage Trends

![March 2025 – March 2026 OpenRouter weekly token usage stacked bar chart (total growing from ~2T to ~26T)](./assets/chart_top_models_trend.png)

## This Week's Top 10 Models

![This week's LLM Leaderboard Top 10](./assets/table_leaderboard.png)

| Rank | Model | Provider | Weekly Token Usage | WoW Change |
|:---:|------|------|:---:|:---:|
| 1 | MiMo-V2-Pro | Xiaomi | 3.96T | +165% |
| 2 | Step 3.5 Flash (free) | Stepfun | 1.49T | +1% |
| 3 | MiniMax M2.7 | MiniMax | 1.29T | +253% |
| 4 | DeepSeek V3.2 | DeepSeek | 1.24T | +9% |
| 5 | Claude Sonnet 4.6 | Anthropic | 1.04T | -0% |
| 6 | Claude Opus 4.6 | Anthropic | 995B | +2% |
| 7 | Gemini 3 Flash Preview | Google | 972B | +3% |
| 8 | GLM 5 Turbo | Zhipu (z-ai) | 968B | -6% |
| 9 | MiniMax M2.5 | MiniMax | 909B | -30% |
| 10 | Grok 4.1 Fast | x-ai | 599B | +32% |

**Key Findings**:
- Chinese providers hold 6 of the top 10 spots (Xiaomi, Stepfun, MiniMax ×2, DeepSeek, Zhipu)
- Xiaomi's MiMo-V2-Pro leads by a wide margin at 3.96T tokens, with 165% week-over-week growth
- MiniMax M2.7 posted the strongest growth at +253% week-over-week
- Anthropic's two models (Sonnet 4.6 + Opus 4.6) combine for roughly 2T tokens, but growth has stalled

## Provider Market Share (by Token Volume)

![Provider market share trend (stacked area chart)](./assets/chart_market_share.png)

![Provider market share ranking](./assets/table_market_share.png)

| Rank | Provider | Weekly Token Volume | Market Share |
|:---:|------|:---:|:---:|
| 1 | Xiaomi | 1.31T | 25.9% |
| 2 | Google | 594B | 11.8% |
| 3 | Anthropic | 555B | 11.0% |
| 4 | MiniMax | 429B | 8.5% |
| 5 | OpenAI | 400B | 7.9% |
| 6 | Stepfun | 341B | 6.8% |
| 7 | DeepSeek | 334B | 6.6% |
| 8 | Zhipu (z-ai) | 326B | 6.5% |
| 9 | x-ai | 195B | 3.9% |
| 10 | Others | 563B | 11.2% |

**Key Findings**:
- Xiaomi leads decisively at 25.9%, more than double the second-place Google
- Combined Chinese provider share: Xiaomi + MiniMax + Stepfun + DeepSeek + Zhipu ≈ 54.3%, exceeding half the market
- OpenAI ranks only fifth at 7.9%
- The market is highly fragmented — no single provider exceeds 30%

## Fastest-Growing Models

| Model | Provider | WoW Growth |
|------|------|:---:|
| MiniMax M2.7 | MiniMax | +253% |
| MiMo-V2-Pro | Xiaomi | +165% |
| Cline (coding agent) | Independent developer | +128% |
| Hermes Agent | Nous Research | +92% |
| Ampere | Ampere | +576% |
| Codex | OpenAI | +112% |

## Top Apps (by Daily Token Consumption)

![Top Apps ranking](./assets/table_top_apps.png)

| Rank | App | Description | Daily Token Volume |
|:---:|------|------|:---:|
| 1 | OpenClaw | AI productivity assistant — "The AI that actually does things" | 829B |
| 2 | Kilo Code | VS Code AI coding assistant | 271B |
| 3 | Claude Code | Anthropic's CLI coding tool | 78B |
| 4 | Cline | VS Code autonomous coding agent | 69.1B |
| 5 | Janitor AI | Character roleplay chat | 29.2B |
| 6 | ISEKAI ZERO | AI adventure game | 28.8B |
| 7 | Descript | AI video/podcast editor | 27B |
| 8 | Hermes Agent | Nous Research's AI agent | 19.2B |
| 9 | Roo Code | VS Code AI coding assistant | 11.8B |
| 10 | Scripty | Newly launched tool | 9.95B |

**Key Findings**:
- The top 4 apps are all **AI coding tools** (OpenClaw, Kilo Code, Claude Code, Cline)
- AI coding agents have become the single largest LLM consumption scenario
- Entertainment/roleplay apps (Janitor AI, ISEKAI ZERO) still hold a notable presence
- OpenClaw consumes 829B tokens per day — nearly 3× the second-place app

## Industry Trend Observations

1. **Chinese Models Break Through Globally**: On OpenRouter, an international platform, Chinese provider models now account for over half of all usage. Xiaomi's MiMo series, DeepSeek V3, and MiniMax's M2 series hold a significant cost-performance advantage.

2. **Flash/Turbo Variants Outpace Flagship Models**: Step 3.5 Flash, GLM 5 Turbo, Gemini 3 Flash, and other "fast and affordable" models see far higher usage than their flagship counterparts. Users are voting with their feet — in real-world applications, speed and cost often matter more than peak performance.

3. **AI Coding Agents Dominate Usage**: 5 of the top 10 apps are coding tools. This reflects the largest commercial value proposition for LLMs today — helping developers write code.

4. **A Highly Fragmented Market**: No single model or provider monopolizes the market. The top 10 spans 8 different providers, signaling that competition remains fierce and the landscape is far from settled.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the 7-slide LLM Usage Landscape deck."""

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE, XL_LEGEND_POSITION, XL_LABEL_POSITION
from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData
import math

# ── colour palette (dark-professional) ──────────────────────────────
BG_DARK   = RGBColor(0x0F, 0x17, 0x2A)   # slide background
BG_CARD   = RGBColor(0x1A, 0x24, 0x3B)   # card / chart bg
ACCENT    = RGBColor(0x38, 0x9C, 0xF0)   # primary blue accent
ACCENT2   = RGBColor(0x00, 0xD4, 0xAA)   # teal accent
ACCENT3   = RGBColor(0xFF, 0x6B, 0x6B)   # red / decline
WHITE     = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
LIGHT     = RGBColor(0xC8, 0xD0, 0xE0)
MUTED     = RGBColor(0x8A, 0x94, 0xA6)
GOLD      = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xD7, 0x00)
GREEN     = RGBColor(0x00, 0xE6, 0x76)
RED       = RGBColor(0xFF, 0x4D, 0x4D)
ROW_ALT   = RGBColor(0x16, 0x1F, 0x34)
HEADER_BG = RGBColor(0x0D, 0x47, 0xA1)
TABLE_HDR = RGBColor(0x14, 0x2D, 0x5E)
TABLE_BDR = RGBColor(0x2A, 0x3A, 0x55)

# Chart colours for pie / bar
PIE_COLORS = [
    RGBColor(0x38, 0x9C, 0xF0),  # Xiaomi  – blue
    RGBColor(0x00, 0xD4, 0xAA),  # Google  – teal
    RGBColor(0xAB, 0x47, 0xBC),  # Anthropic – purple
    RGBColor(0xFF, 0xCA, 0x28),  # MiniMax – gold
    RGBColor(0xFF, 0x6B, 0x6B),  # OpenAI  – coral
    RGBColor(0x26, 0xC6, 0xDA),  # Stepfun – cyan
    RGBColor(0x66, 0xBB, 0x6A),  # DeepSeek – green
    RGBColor(0xFF, 0xA7, 0x26),  # Zhipu   – orange
    RGBColor(0xEF, 0x53, 0x50),  # x-ai    – red
    RGBColor(0x78, 0x90, 0x9C),  # Others  – grey
]

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width  = Inches(13.333)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)
SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

# ── helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def set_slide_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color

def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                color=WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
                font_name='Calibri'):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox

def add_paragraph(text_frame, text, font_size=14, color=LIGHT, bold=False,
                  space_before=Pt(6), alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name='Calibri'):
    p = text_frame.add_paragraph()
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.space_before = space_before
    p.alignment = alignment
    return p

def add_accent_line(slide, left, top, width, color=ACCENT):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
        1, left, top, width, Pt(3)  # MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE = 1
    )
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

def add_card(slide, left, top, width, height, color=BG_CARD):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.color.rgb = TABLE_BDR
    shape.line.width = Pt(0.5)
    return shape

def fmt_change(val):
    """Format WoW change like '+165%' or '-30%'."""
    if isinstance(val, str):
        if val.startswith('-') and val.rstrip('%-').lstrip('-').replace('.','').isdigit():
            num = float(val.rstrip('%').replace('+',''))
            if num == 0:
                return "flat"
            return val if '%' in val else val + '%'
        return val
    if val >= 0:
        return f"+{int(val)}%" if val == int(val) else f"+{val}%"
    return f"{int(val)}%" if val == int(val) else f"{val}%"

# ── SLIDE 1: Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
slide1 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])  # blank
set_slide_bg(slide1, BG_DARK)

# Accent line at top
add_accent_line(slide1, Inches(1.2), Inches(1.6), Inches(2.5), ACCENT)

# Title
add_textbox(slide1, Inches(1.2), Inches(1.8), Inches(10), Inches(1.5),
            "The 2025 LLM Usage Landscape", font_size=40, color=WHITE, bold=True)
add_textbox(slide1, Inches(1.2), Inches(2.9), Inches(10), Inches(0.8),
            "Real-World Data from OpenRouter", font_size=26, color=ACCENT, bold=False)

# Subtitle
add_textbox(slide1, Inches(1.2), Inches(4.0), Inches(9), Inches(0.6),
            "Based on real usage data from millions of OpenRouter users, this deck reveals "
            "the competitive landscape and emerging trends in today's LLM market.",
            font_size=14, color=LIGHT)

# KPI cards
kpi_data = [
    ("26T+", "Tokens Processed\nThis Week"),
    ("10", "Models in the\nTop Leaderboard"),
    ("8", "Different Providers\nin Top 10"),
    ("54%+", "Combined Chinese\nProvider Share"),
]
card_w = Inches(2.5)
card_h = Inches(1.4)
start_x = Inches(1.2)
gap = Inches(0.35)
for i, (num, label) in enumerate(kpi_data):
    x = start_x + i * (card_w + gap)
    add_card(slide1, x, Inches(5.2), card_w, card_h)
    add_textbox(slide1, x + Inches(0.2), Inches(5.3), Inches(2.1), Inches(0.7),
                num, font_size=28, color=ACCENT, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    add_textbox(slide1, x + Inches(0.2), Inches(5.9), Inches(2.1), Inches(0.6),
                label, font_size=11, color=LIGHT, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Source footer
add_textbox(slide1, Inches(1.2), Inches(6.9), Inches(10), Inches(0.4),
            "Source: OpenRouter Rankings — Latest week of March 2025",
            font_size=10, color=MUTED)

# ── SLIDE 2: Top 10 Models (table) ─────────────────────────────────
slide2 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide2, BG_DARK)

add_accent_line(slide2, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.5), Inches(2), ACCENT)
add_textbox(slide2, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.6), Inches(11), Inches(0.7),
            "This Week's Top 10 Models", font_size=30, color=WHITE, bold=True)
add_textbox(slide2, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.2), Inches(11), Inches(0.5),
            "Ranked by weekly token usage on OpenRouter", font_size=14, color=MUTED)

# Table data
models = [
    ("1",  "MiMo-V2-Pro",          "Xiaomi",      "3.96T",  "+165%"),
    ("2",  "Step 3.5 Flash (free)","Stepfun",      "1.49T",  "+1%"),
    ("3",  "MiniMax M2.7",         "MiniMax",      "1.29T",  "+253%"),
    ("4",  "DeepSeek V3.2",        "DeepSeek",     "1.24T",  "+9%"),
    ("5",  "Claude Sonnet 4.6",    "Anthropic",    "1.04T",  "flat"),
    ("6",  "Claude Opus 4.6",      "Anthropic",    "995B",   "+2%"),
    ("7",  "Gemini 3 Flash Preview","Google",      "972B",   "+3%"),
    ("8",  "GLM 5 Turbo",          "Zhipu (z-ai)", "968B",   "-6%"),
    ("9",  "MiniMax M2.5",         "MiniMax",      "909B",   "-30%"),
    ("10", "Grok 4.1 Fast",        "x-ai",         "599B",   "+32%"),
]

rows, cols = len(models) + 1, 5
tbl_left = Inches(0.8)
tbl_top  = Inches(1.8)
tbl_w    = Inches(11.7)
tbl_h    = Inches(4.8)

table_shape = slide2.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, tbl_left, tbl_top, tbl_w, tbl_h)
tbl = table_shape.table

col_widths = [Inches(0.7), Inches(3.5), Inches(2.5), Inches(2.5), Inches(2.5)]
for i, w in enumerate(col_widths):
    tbl.columns[i].width = w

# Header row
headers = ["Rank", "Model", "Provider", "Weekly Tokens", "WoW Change"]
for j, h in enumerate(headers):
    cell = tbl.cell(0, j)
    cell.text = h
    cell.fill.solid()
    cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = TABLE_HDR
    for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
        p.font.size = Pt(13)
        p.font.color.rgb = WHITE
        p.font.bold = True
        p.font.name = 'Calibri'
        p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    cell.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE

# Data rows
for i, row_data in enumerate(models):
    for j, val in enumerate(row_data):
        cell = tbl.cell(i + 1, j)
        cell.text = val
        # alternating row bg
        if i % 2 == 0:
            cell.fill.solid()
            cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = BG_CARD
        else:
            cell.fill.solid()
            cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = ROW_ALT
        for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            p.font.size = Pt(12)
            p.font.name = 'Calibri'
            p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER if j in (0, 3, 4) else PP_ALIGN.LEFT
            # WoW change colouring
            if j == 4:
                if val.startswith('+'):
                    p.font.color.rgb = GREEN
                    p.font.bold = True
                elif val.startswith('-'):
                    p.font.color.rgb = RED
                    p.font.bold = True
                else:
                    p.font.color.rgb = MUTED
            elif j == 0:
                p.font.color.rgb = ACCENT
                p.font.bold = True
            elif j == 1:
                p.font.color.rgb = WHITE
                p.font.bold = True
            else:
                p.font.color.rgb = LIGHT
        cell.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE
    # Remove cell borders
    for j in range(cols):
        cell = tbl.cell(i + 1, j)
        for border_name in ['bottom', 'top', 'left', 'right']:
            try:
                border = getattr(cell, border_name + '_border', None) or cell._tc.xpath('.//a:ln')
            except Exception:
                pass

txBox = slide2.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(6.7), Inches(11.7), Inches(0.6))
tf = txBox.text_frame
tf.word_wrap = True
p = tf.paragraphs[0]
p.text = "Key: Chinese providers hold 6 of 10 spots  |  Xiaomi leads at 3.96T tokens (+165% WoW)  |  MiniMax M2.7 surged +253%"
p.font.size = Pt(11)
p.font.color.rgb = ACCENT2
p.font.name = 'Calibri'

# ── SLIDE 3: Provider Market Share (pie chart) ─────────────────────
slide3 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide3, BG_DARK)

add_accent_line(slide3, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.5), Inches(2), ACCENT)
add_textbox(slide3, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.6), Inches(11), Inches(0.7),
            "Provider Market Share Breakdown", font_size=30, color=WHITE, bold=True)
add_textbox(slide3, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.2), Inches(11), Inches(0.5),
            "Share of total token volume across all models and apps on OpenRouter",
            font_size=14, color=MUTED)

# Pie chart
chart_data = CategoryChartData()
chart_data.categories = ['Xiaomi', 'Google', 'Anthropic', 'MiniMax', 'OpenAI',
                          'Stepfun', 'DeepSeek', 'Zhipu', 'x-ai', 'Others']
chart_data.add_series('Market Share', (25.9, 11.8, 11.0, 8.5, 7.9, 6.8, 6.6, 6.5, 3.9, 11.2))

chart_frame = slide3.shapes.add_chart(
    XL_CHART_TYPE.PIE, Inches(0.5), Inches(1.8), Inches(7), Inches(5.2),
    chart_data
)
chart = chart_frame.chart
chart.has_legend = True
chart.legend.position = XL_LEGEND_POSITION.BOTTOM
chart.legend.include_in_layout = False
chart.legend.font.size = Pt(10)
chart.legend.font.color.rgb = LIGHT
chart.legend.font.name = 'Calibri'

plot = chart.plots[0]
plot.has_data_labels = True
data_labels = plot.data_labels
data_labels.number_format = '0.0"%"'
data_labels.font.size = Pt(10)
data_labels.font.color.rgb = WHITE
data_labels.font.bold = True
data_labels.font.name = 'Calibri'
data_labels.show_percentage = False
data_labels.show_value = True
data_labels.show_category_name = False

# Color each slice
series = chart.series[0]
for i, color in enumerate(PIE_COLORS):
    point = series.points[i]
    point.format.fill.solid()
    point.format.fill.fore_color.rgb = color

# Chart background
chart.chart_style = 2
chart_frame.chart.element.attrib.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart}style', None)

# Right-side annotations
add_card(slide3, Inches(7.8), Inches(1.8), Inches(4.8), Inches(2.2))
txBox = slide3.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(8.0), Inches(1.9), Inches(4.4), Inches(2.0))

set_slide_bg(slide4, BG_DARK)

def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                color=WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,

    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name

    p.alignment = alignment

def fmt_change(val):
    """Format WoW change like '+165%' or '-30%'."""
    if isinstance(val, str):
        if val.startswith('-') and val.rstrip('%-').lstrip('-').replace('.','').isdigit():
            num = float(val.rstrip('%').replace('+',''))
            if num == 0:
                return "flat"
            return val if '%' in val else val + '%'
        return val
    if val >= 0:
        return f"+{int(val)}%" if val == int(val) else f"+{val}%"
    return f"{int(val)}%" if val == int(val) else f"{val}%"
